/bin/bash -lc "cat >> docs/fidelity.md <<'EOF'


### Live actor movement and ordered behavior dispatch

- World now calls the recovered actor movement module before its active part updates. Tank owns "'`ActorMovementState`; the legacy direct-steering AI and its turn counters are removed. The artwork-only procedural phase offset remains independent. Primary weapons still precede registered behavior parts, whose authored order decides the shared next-frame destination. Aggressor, Skittish and Wall Flower now consume their recovered target/destination rules; Phasing retains its canonical signed8.8 clock. Healer writes the patient destination after the existing beam/patient update, whose previously documented bounded acquisition differences remain outstanding.
- Factory construction now interleaves each registered behavior'"'s Setup acquisition with later behavior constructors. A duplicate clip still consumes its constructor rolls before registration rejects it, but does not run Setup. Skittish sets its flag before the first movement frame. Movement Setup starts at the constructor's origin, before external placement. A controlled seven-draw fixture verifies Phasing, rejected Phasing, Wall Flower frequency/amplitude and later Setup order. Other part constructors and primary-weapon Setup/target draws are not yet source-complete.
- "'`ActorParents` tracks actor references through field layers separately from active target populations. Queued dead enemies keep their parent until removal; a replacement avatar is a different object. An outgoing wrapper loses the stage root while its retained layer/actors remain parented; reattachment creates a fresh wrapper and reparents cached enemies. Main'"'s centered game root and the supplied Bubblefield's identity enemy-layer placement determine the translation terms. Parent point conversion follows the reference [local/global Point twip boundaries](https://github.com/ruffle-rs/ruffle/blob/v0.7.1/core/src/avm2/globals/flash/display/display_object.rs#L968-L1009), rather than applying display quantization to private Wall Flower vectors. The parent records use snapshots of the existing World camera coordinates; complete per-camera-assignment accumulation and shrinking/non-finite matrix edge cases still require reference comparison.
- New live regressions cover preceding-rotation/twip translation, authored Wall Flower/Aggressor overwrites, Skittish's first safety turn, jam/reset/stun/pause, constructor/Setup draws, post-run patient points and retained outgoing allies using current-wrapper populations. Parent tests separately cover both field directions, twip conversion, cached unrooting/reparenting, removal, avatar replacement and repeated membership synchronization. The legacy AI fails the movement regression with 2.08/0.08/0 instead of 2.05/0.05/3; its baseline receives only an inert movement-state field to reach that comparison.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 650 unit/parser/rule tests (7,036 assertions), production build and eight distinct affected supplied-SWF/mock browser cases pass without skips. These cover the new behavior gallery, both active crossing populations, Phasing paint and fresh-game pilots through boss/win. The final gallery also samples frames 1/2/3 to prove two old-heading translations before the pursuit turn, retains the travelling Wall Flower point and checks all motion/private clocks across pause; its two final cases pass in 7.6 seconds before a gallery aspect-ratio correction. Final capture verification is recorded below. Pilots use the existing upgrade-selection adapter; they do not establish a human or synchronized original-runtime playthrough.
- All 14 original "'`928a5c6` paths are accounted by #105–#109 and this live integration candidate, with source-backed corrections to float order, display values, target references and repeated acquisition. The checkpoint remains unlanded until those PRs merge. Full weapon target/Aim ordering, Healer overrides, all-constructor/Setup RNG/event interleaving, precise camera/matrix lifecycle and synchronized original-runtime/Adobe/game parity remain unfinished.
EOF
cat >> docs/architecture.md <<'"'EOF'

"'`simulation/actor-movement.ts` now owns active enemy/ally translation and delayed turn plans; `Tank.movement` replaces legacy steering counters. Registered behavior parts run after primary weapons and movement through `behaviors.ts`, consuming the separate destination, target-acquisition and Phasing modules. `ActorParents` owns simulation-only parent records: it distinguishes actor removal from unrooting an outgoing field wrapper and reparenting cached actors. It supplies parent-relative points without renderer objects or an active-only UID lookup. Parent records currently derive from World camera snapshots; per-assignment camera precision and matrix edge cases remain fidelity work. Healer retains its existing beam/patient owner until its overridden acquisition/Aim rules are recovered.
EOF

actor movement using preceding turn

  → authored registered behaviors
